notes: A fix for the Visual Sitemap's color rules. Picking a section under "Top-level section" could save the rule against a different section — usually the level above — and reopening it showed a third one, as though the choice hadn't stuck. It had: the list was offering the wrong values behind the right names. Related, and the reason it went unnoticed: on a sitemap built under a single root page the whole tree counted as one section, so coloring by section colored everything alike, in the Visual Sitemap and the Treemap both. The sections beneath a lone root are now treated as the sections. If you already have a section color rule in a sitemap like that, it was matching the entire tree and now matches just the root — re-point it at the section you actually meant.
